He crossed the plain to the south, where the brick gangs were building the walls near the Terrace, and I followed him as a boy, learning the measure of the bricks and the weight of the clay. I now live in the mud house just beyond the stairs, where my sons and wife work with me every day.",
    "memories": [
        "At the dawn of the month Tābān, my father and I carried a load of wet bricks to the north wall near the gate; he said the mortar must be thick, by Napiriša, or the wall will crack.",
